source:
Ana: We should stay fully remote because autonomy matters more than collaboration for our work.
Rob: We should return to the office because collaboration matters more than autonomy for our work.

extraction.mainQuestion: Should the team stay fully remote?

positions.label: Stay fully remote
positions.thesis: The team should stay fully remote because autonomy matters more than collaboration for this work.
positions.steelman: Deep individual work is the product; protecting autonomy protects the output.

groundingQuotes.quote: We should stay fully remote because autonomy matters more than collaboration for our work.

positions.label: Return to the office
positions.thesis: The team should return to the office because collaboration matters more than autonomy for this work.
positions.steelman: Shared space produces the informal coordination that individual autonomy cannot replace.

groundingQuotes.quote: We should return to the office because collaboration matters more than autonomy for our work.

claims.statement: Autonomy matters more than collaboration for this work.

groundingQuotes.quote: autonomy matters more than collaboration for our work

claims.statement: Collaboration matters more than autonomy for this work.

groundingQuotes.quote: collaboration matters more than autonomy for our work

commonGroundCandidates.statement: Both autonomy and collaboration matter for the team's work.

disagreementCandidates.question: Which matters more for this work: autonomy or collaboration?
disagreementCandidates.summary: A direct values weighting dispute; neither side offers facts that could settle it.
disagreementCandidates.resolutionCondition: The sides make explicit what work outcomes they are optimizing for.

claimStakeCandidates.targetConclusion: The team should stay fully remote.
claimStakeCandidates.consequence: The value weighting is the whole argument; the source does not state what empirical finding would change Ana's weighting.

groundingQuotes.quote: autonomy matters more than collaboration for our work

claimStakeCandidates.targetConclusion: The team should return to the office.
claimStakeCandidates.consequence: The value weighting is the whole argument; the source does not state what empirical finding would change Rob's weighting.

groundingQuotes.quote: collaboration matters more than autonomy for our work

caveats: A values weighting cannot be settled by evidence alone; the report maps it, it does not resolve it.
